title: Simulation causes Alembic Avatar to Reset
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/075e02f79c6d4b4689c7813c499c61b7/images/9cea28cde3e24a6d8c30c8a61f948e97Issue.png)

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BmwsMDTddiM?start=0

Hey guys, does anybody know how to fix this issue?  
  
I used to be able to import an Alembic Avatar, reposition and rotate it, run the simulation, which would drape the clothes over the Alembic Avatar, and then play the Alembic Avatar animation so the cloth would follow and react to the animation.   
Now when I start the start the simulation, the Alembic Avatar resets to its default position it's in upon first importing it into the scene, causing the cloth to distort.   
Simulation Settings are Normal (Default), using GPU(same happens with CPU though) and Particle Distance of all cloth is set to 20mm.  
Latest graphics drivers and Marvelous Designer versions are installed.   
Any help would be much appreciated!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Please share your project file with us through our 'Contact Us' page.🙏🏻https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/075e02f79c6d4b4689c7813c499c61b7 will be the best way to see what is going on there.
content_description: This web page serves as a community support forum for troubleshooting issues with importing and simulating Alembic Avatars in Marvelous Designer.

title: Issue with Gizmo cannot be manipulated for Trims
content:
Hi everyone, I am a beginner in Marvelous Designer and I have a question about the Gizmo.

When I select a Trim in the 3D window, the Gizmo does appear, but I cannot interact with it. Even if I try to click and drag the arrows or circles on the Gizmo, it doesn't move, rotate, or scale at all. I can only move the Trim by clicking the object itself and dragging it.

Does anyone know why the Gizmo is unresponsive for Trims and how I can fix this? Thank you!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Could you please upload a video showcasing the issue? Bes ure that you are not in the Glue mode. There are 2 icons whenever you select a Trim., one for the Glue and the other one to transform with the Gizmo.
Reply 1: Please watch this video. I can control the Gizmo for fabric, but not for trims.https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/6dcd7f658e5540b19e0d9dff365d8979
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to seek assistance from the community regarding the unresponsive Gizmo in Marvelous Designer when working with Trims, and to share solutions for this issue.

title: LiveSync 5.7 - a little help, please? :)
content:
So, Adobe finally updated the Substance plugin - yay! Except, I'm having a major issue with materials on geometry cache garments. The character without the shadow is wearing a 5.7 LiveSync garment. The other character has a garment from prior to 5.6. Notice that not only does the 5.7 garment not have a shadow, it's also kind of glowing. The result is the same whether I import it with Translucency or Opacity mask. I have no idea what I'm doing wrong. Is anyone else experiencing this? Thanks.![18634a23916d4924968507c1d194252d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202601/d688f1691a404942ba84468a216b8d07/images/18634a23916d4924968507c1d194252dMD_LiveSync_issue.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Solved-ish. I created a new 5.7 project, used LiveSync to import the same garment/animation from MD, and the materials are fine. I migrated that geometry cache to my actual project, and the materials are still okay, so I guess something in my project caused this - maybe a plugin that clashes with LiveSync? - I don't know.
Reply 1: Hi Melissa, glad to hear that it is 'somewhat' resolved! I'll test this with our developers to see if there is anything you should look out for when using Substance materials. As far as I'm concerned, there shouldn't be any issues, apart from having to organize UV maps in MD when using the Unified UV Coordinate option.
content_description: "Seek solutions and share experiences regarding issues with materials on geometry cache garments after the latest Adobe Substance plugin update."
